title: Exterior products commute with the compact-support projection transformation
statement:
Use the finite-field datum and finite coefficient ring $A=A_{E,n}$ and the actual operations of [sk-def-sf-operations], on separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be separated finite-type morphisms, $M_i\in D^b_{ctf}(X_i,A)$ and $B_i\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_i,A)$, for $i=1,2$. Put $f=f_1\times f_2$, $M=M_1\boxtimes M_2$, $B=B_1\boxtimes B_2$ and $C_i=M_i\otimes^LLf_i^*B_i$. Let $\operatorname{PF}_{f,M,B}:Rf_!M\otimes^LB\to Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*B)$ be the specified projection transformation [def-exchange-projection]. Let $K_M:Rf_!(M_1\boxtimes M_2)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{1!}M_1\boxtimes Rf_{2!}M_2$ and $K_C:Rf_!(C_1\boxtimes C_2)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{1!}C_1\boxtimes Rf_{2!}C_2$ be precisely the maps $\mathrm{Ku}_!$ of [sk-def-sf-kv-maps](i). Let $\delta:M\otimes^LLf^*B\xrightarrow{\sim}C_1\boxtimes C_2$ be the canonical pullback-composition, monoidal pullback and signed tensor interchange, and let $\xi:(Rf_{1!}M_1\boxtimes Rf_{2!}M_2)\otimes^LB\xrightarrow{\sim}(Rf_{1!}M_1\otimes^LB_1)\boxtimes(Rf_{2!}M_2\otimes^LB_2)$ be signed tensor interchange on the targets. Then the following equality of specified natural morphisms holds:
$$K_C\circ Rf_!(\delta)\circ\operatorname{PF}_{f,M,B}=(\operatorname{PF}_{f_1,M_1,B_1}\boxtimes\operatorname{PF}_{f_2,M_2,B_2})\circ\xi\circ(K_M\otimes1_B).$$
All tensors are derived over the constant sheaf $A$. No exceptional inverse image or external internal-Hom comparison occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Beta, last sentence, projection-formula compatibility needed before applying the exceptional counits; the canonical Ku_! is the relative product composite of sk-thm-sf-kunneth-relative.
